text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Watching the students come and go from 
here, I sometimes feel a truly magnificent 
wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Spring gales... or perhaps sweeping 
winds... They calm as a gentle eddying 
breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
To the point where, if you let your guard 
down for even a second, you could be blown 
completely away...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
However, if I catch this as a headwind and 
set sail, I feel it could become the most 
favorable wind of all for me.
